data.description:
## testing_mode: RED

## What
Create tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh with 8 failing test functions. Create fixture directories under tests/fixtures/degradations/ with fully populated JSON event files. All tests must FAIL because the script does not yet exist.

## Test Functions (all fail — script absent)
1. test_no_events(): TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR=tests/fixtures/degradations bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-unacked-degradations.sh no-events; expect exit 0
2. test_no_degradation_entries(): runs against 'no-degradation' fixture; expect exit 0
3. test_all_acked(): 'all-acked' fixture (degradation:true + matching ACK); expect exit 0
4. test_one_unacked(): 'one-unacked' (degradation:true decision_ids:["sess:def456"], no ACK); expect exit 1 AND "sess:def456" in stdout
5. test_partial_ack(): 'partial-ack' (2 ids ["sess:ghi","sess:jkl"], ACK for only "sess:ghi"); expect exit 1, "sess:jkl" in stdout, "sess:ghi" NOT in stdout
6. test_fail_open(): 'fail-open' (malformed JSON PRECONDITIONS file); expect exit 0
7. test_multiple_unacked(): 'multiple-unacked' (2 ids ["sess:pqr","sess:stu"], no ACK); expect exit 1 AND BOTH "sess:pqr" AND "sess:stu" in stdout (one per line)
8. test_no_preconditions_file(): 'no-preconditions-file' (dir contains only a STATUS.json file, no *-PRECONDITIONS.json); expect exit 0 (pre-manifest exemption)

## Fixture JSON Files to Create
All PRECONDITIONS fixture files must include the event_type envelope field per preconditions-schema-v2.md.

- tests/fixtures/degradations/no-events/: empty directory (no files)
- tests/fixtures/degradations/no-degradation/: 2024-01-01T000000-PRECONDITIONS.json → {"event_type":"PRECONDITIONS","schema_version":2,"data":{}}
- tests/fixtures/degradations/all-acked/: 2024-01-01T000000-PRECONDITIONS.json → {"event_type":"PRECONDITIONS","schema_version":2,"data":{"degradation":true,"decision_ids":["sess:abc123"]}}, 2024-01-01T000001-ACK.json → {"decision_ids":["sess:abc123"],"schema_version":1}
- tests/fixtures/degradations/one-unacked/: 2024-01-01T000000-PRECONDITIONS.json → {"event_type":"PRECONDITIONS","schema_version":2,"data":{"degradation":true,"decision_ids":["sess:def456"]}}
- tests/fixtures/degradations/partial-ack/: 2024-01-01T000000-PRECONDITIONS.json → {"event_type":"PRECONDITIONS","schema_version":2,"data":{"degradation":true,"decision_ids":["sess:ghi","sess:jkl"]}}, 2024-01-01T000001-ACK.json → {"decision_ids":["sess:ghi"],"schema_version":1}
- tests/fixtures/degradations/fail-open/: 2024-01-01T000000-PRECONDITIONS.json → NOT VALID JSON (literal content)
- tests/fixtures/degradations/multiple-unacked/: 2024-01-01T000000-PRECONDITIONS.json → {"event_type":"PRECONDITIONS","schema_version":2,"data":{"degradation":true,"decision_ids":["sess:pqr","sess:stu"]}}
- tests/fixtures/degradations/no-preconditions-file/: 2024-01-01T000000-STATUS.json → {"event_type":"STATUS","status":"open"}

## .test-index RED Marker Format
Add one RED marker per test function. Format: plugins/dso/scripts/check-unacked-degradations.sh:tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh [test_no_events]
(and similarly for each of the 8 functions).

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Universal: lint passes
   Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py (N/A if no Python files added)
2. Test file is executable
   Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh
3. Fixture JSON files exist (spot check)
   Verify: test -f tests/fixtures/degradations/one-unacked/2024-01-01T000000-PRECONDITIONS.json && test -f tests/fixtures/degradations/multiple-unacked/2024-01-01T000000-PRECONDITIONS.json && test -f tests/fixtures/degradations/no-preconditions-file/2024-01-01T000000-STATUS.json
4. All 8 RED markers in .test-index with proper format
   Verify: for fn in test_no_events test_no_degradation_entries test_all_acked test_one_unacked test_partial_ack test_fail_open test_multiple_unacked test_no_preconditions_file; do grep -q "check-unacked-degradations.sh:tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh \[\]" .test-index || exit 1; done
5. Tests fail currently (script absent)
   Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh; test $? -ne 0
data.title: Write RED test suite and fixture JSON data for check-unacked-degradations.sh (8 failing tests)
